Register of Deeds in York County, Nebraska
The Register of Deeds Office contains all land records for York County. To search Register of Deeds information online, please visit Nebraska Deeds Online .
*Please note: records filed prior to 2003 are not available on NE Deeds Online. They can be researched in the Clerk’s Office on designated public computers.
​Documents are accepted for filing through E-Recording systems Simplifile and CSC, mail and over the counter. Documents are accepted Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
For questions, please call (402) 362-7759 (Ext. 5) or email rod@yorkcountyne.gov
